title: Multimodal Requirements Traceability Link Recovery in Industrial Settings
abstract: arXiv:2610.34503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Requirements traceability links support activities such as change-impact analysis, coverage checking, and validation. Industrial requirements can include traceable images, which text-only approaches cannot process directly. For a fixed classifier configuration, binary decisions alone offer no direct way to adjust the balance between missed and incorrect links. We extend a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach for inter-requirements traceability link recovery (TLR). Our extension retrieves text and image candidates separately, classifies each retrieved pair with a vision-language model, and filters the predicted links by verbalized confidence. We evaluate our approach on three non-overlapping industrial requirement sets and six public text-only datasets. translated_title: 工业环境中的多模态需求可追溯性链接恢复
translated_abstract: 需求可追溯性链接可以支持变更影响分析、覆盖率检查和验证等活动。工业需求中可能包含可追溯的图像，而纯文本方法无法直接处理这些图像。对于固定的分类器配置而言，仅依靠二元决策无法直接调整漏检链接与错误链接之间的平衡。我们扩展了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的需求间可追溯性链接恢复（TLR）方法。我们的扩展方法分别检索文本和图像候选，使用视觉-语言模型对每个检索到的配对进行分类，并通过言语化置信度对预测的链接进行过滤。我们在三个互不重叠的工业需求集合和六个公开的纯文本数据集上评估了我们的方法。在工业测试集上，我们的方法取得了0.310的F1分数，而我们对Hey等人基线方法的复现仅达到0.114。我们的方法恢复的链接（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多模态RAG扩展方法，通过分别检索文本和图像候选、利用视觉-语言模型进行分类并用言语化置信度过滤预测链接，从而在工业需求可追溯性链接恢复任务中将F1分数从基线的0.114提升至0.310。
en_tdlr: This paper extends a RAG-based approach with multimodal text and image candidate retrieval, vision-language model classification, and verbalized-confidence filtering, improving industrial requirements traceability link recovery F1 from 0.114 to 0.310 over the baseline.
